title: Hearty German Potato Casserole
description: A comforting German dish featuring charred potatoes and melted butter, this casserole is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the chopped onions and minced garlic over medium heat until they are lightly browned.
Add the sliced potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour and melted butter until smooth.
Add the flour mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the potato mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with sour cream and chopped parsley.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is lightly browned.
